verdict: REPLICATES -- in PHENYLEPHRINE (independent alpha-1 agent), a stable-epoch dose-REQUIREMENT phenotype exists in 82 patients, varies ~4.1-fold between patients (p10-p90), split-half reliability 0.806, and early-half->late-half Spearman 0.278.
